builds.name: Reference: Long-range finish
builds.goal: Reference for Miss Fortune: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged damage dealer who exploits target changes and Q bounces, then channels R through a controlled firing lane. E provides a slow field for setup and poke. Separate Love Tap target switching, Q bounce conditions and complete R waves. AP burn is a deliberate E-zone experiment and must not claim AD/crit effects on all spell damage. Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
builds.summary: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Miss Fortune: Separate Love Tap target switching, Q bounce conditions and complete R waves. AP burn is a deliberate E-zone experiment and must not claim AD/crit effects on all spell damage.

Start with the early core (Collector, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.

The route fails Miss Fortune's stated kit question: Separate Love Tap target switching, Q bounce conditions and complete R waves. AP burn is a deliberate E-zone experiment and must not claim AD/crit effects on all spell damage.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Collector, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.summary: Test rain hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test rain hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Make It Rain deals 0.6 AP magic damage per second over two seconds and its slow scales with AP; Torch and Liandry reward the sustained zone. Q and R retain AP ratios but physical damage, so magic penetration chiefly supports E and item magic packets.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy stays in E and long-range poke precedes a safe R.
Measure E-only damage and then full R physical damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD makes physical Bullet Time disappointing against armor.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration cannot improve physical Bullet Time merely because R has an AP ratio.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blackfire Torch, Liandry's Torment, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
